card.method_meaning: L2-logistic propensity scores with greedy 1:1 nearest-neighbour matching (caliper 0.1) and stabilized IPTW weights; diagnostics only, no effect estimation
card.population_assumption: complete-case numeric confounders; origin run on a synthetic imbalanced fixture (seed 7, n_t=150, n_c=600)
card.timing_assumption: retrospective analysis on a frozen data extract; no observation-window or real-time constraint

validation_evidence.note: origin run: L2 logistic PS + greedy 1:1 match (caliper 0.1, seed 42) on the imbalance fixture; post-match SMD < 0.1 on both covariates
deterministic rerun on identical fixed data with kernel seeds pinned under a different process-global RNG state (numpy seed 999 vs 7); output digest byte-identical. NOT a fresh data draw.
intended reuse is confounding adjustment on complete-case covariates, inside the card population; no clinical transport claimed

issued_note: Issued 2026-09-18 on synthetic fixtures; origin bounds the claim to method mechanics (see card population assumption). Reproduction is deterministic rerun, not fresh data.
